Every icon below is drawn by the extension as this page renders.
The site sets `octicon` as its default set.

## Naming an icon

| Source | Renders as |
| --- | --- |
| `{{{< iconify octicon:rocket-16 >}}}` | {{< iconify octicon:rocket-16 >}} |
| `{{{< iconify octicon rocket-16 >}}}` | {{< iconify octicon rocket-16 >}} |
| `{{{< iconify mdi:home >}}}` | {{< iconify mdi:home >}} |
| `{{{< iconify simple-icons:quarto >}}}` | {{< iconify simple-icons:quarto >}} |

: The two syntaxes, and icons from three sets. {.striped .hover tbl-colwidths="[55,45]"}

## Style

`style` takes any inline CSS, which is how an icon is coloured in HTML:

| Source | Renders as |
| --- | --- |
| `{{{< iconify mdi:heart size=2x style="color: firebrick;" >}}}` | {{< iconify mdi:heart size=2x style="color: firebrick;" >}} |

: Colouring an icon in HTML. {.striped .hover tbl-colwidths="[55,45]"}

The `color` attribute is for Typst output, where the colour is baked into the retrieved SVG.

## Accessibility

Every icon is announced, so label every icon.

```markdown
{{{< iconify octicon:alert-16 label="Warning" title="Warning" >}}}
```

{{< iconify octicon:alert-16 size=2x label="Warning" title="Warning" >}} carries an `aria-label` and a tooltip reading `Warning`.

Left unset, both fall back to a generated string naming the set and the file:

| Source | Announced as |
| --- | --- |
| `{{{< iconify octicon:alert-16 >}}}` | `Icon alert-16 from octicon Iconify.design set.` |
| `{{{< iconify octicon:alert-16 label="Warning" >}}}` | `Warning` |

: What a screen reader reads out, with and without a label. {.striped .hover tbl-colwidths="[55,45]"}

## The Quarto icon

`quarto` is a second shortcode, drawing `simple-icons:quarto` in the Quarto blue:

| Source | Renders as |
| --- | --- |
| `{{{< quarto >}}}` | {{< quarto >}} |
| `{{{< quarto size=2x >}}}` | {{< quarto size=2x >}} |

: The `quarto` shortcode, which takes the same attributes as `iconify`. {.striped .hover tbl-colwidths="[55,45]"}

## Defaults

Set them once and drop them from every shortcode:

```yaml
extensions:
  iconify:
    set: octicon
    size: 1.2em
    inline: true
```

With a default set, `{{{< iconify rocket-16 >}}}` is enough: {{< iconify rocket-16 >}}.

## When an icon cannot be loaded

```yaml
extensions:
  iconify:
    fallback: "•"
```

The fallback is shown when the name is wrong, the CDN is unreachable, or the reader is offline.

Preloading avoids the question entirely, and needs the filter as well as the shortcode:

```yaml
filters:
  - iconify
extensions:
  iconify:
    preload:
      - icons/octicon.json
```

The repository ships a short, standalone starting point you can copy: [`example.qmd`](https://github.com/mcanouil/quarto-iconify/blob/main/example.qmd).
